## Changes

- [**Added Solitaire**](https://github.com/0xTas/meteor-minigames-addon/commit/1ab82ca350896021df1aad2165cd3e9dedf7902c) - What more could you ask for?
- [**Meteorites**](https://github.com/0xTas/meteor-minigames-addon/commit/833ba8670dc20b2d3791e13cbd0491b1aad362ce) - Made collapsing the game window always pause the game.
- [**Minesweeper Improvements**](https://github.com/0xTas/meteor-minigames-addon/commit/a96f3d377e45bb9832a95e74bfda1a1dfa71dfc1) - Added chording, hovered & clicked cell highlighting, and made cells reveal only on mouse release.

For a full list of changes since the last release, please see the [commit history.](https://github.com/0xTas/meteor-minigames-addon/commits/main/)

---
## Known Issues
**Meteor's triangle rendering is currently broken on versions 1.21.5 and above, so the Meteorites minigame is currently not working on any version other than 1.21.4**.
